The cartridge disagrees on two independent counts: both factories store this class's vptr 0x021379d8 and inline its constructor, and ov096 has exactly two static initializers and two .ctor entries for what tu_map calls four TUs. The cartridge owns it at arm9:0x020072c0 and an enrolled source already reaches it, so this object's copy is a byte-identical duplicate that production isolation discards. It lies outside this entry's licensed range (.text 0x02135700-0x02136db0).

This TU defines every virtual daSanbo_c declares -- the ten overrides plus the D1/D0 pair from the inline destructor in include/daSanbo_c.h -- so mwcc anchors the complete 0x84-byte vtable storage here whatever the declaration order. The cartridge keeps it in ov096 .data: the object begins at 0x021379d0 with the offset-to-top and typeinfo words, and symbols.txt names the address point eight bytes later at 0x021379d8, which is the spelling this row must carry and the spelling romdata_check corrects for. ov096 delinks no .data at all, so nothing this entry claims (.text 0x02135700-0x02136db0) reaches those bytes; dsd supplies them from the cartridge and production isolation discards the emitted duplicate. 31 slots.
